items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I played with the little band that he had with him.

ctx.x: Really, yes. Did you have any other encounters, or work with anybody else that was well known?

Well, I remember one time Step 'n Fetchit, who you know who he was, the old comedian, Step 'n Fetchit came through Louisiana, and he was sort of a scout, he was scouting around for talent for the studios, you know. He was quite a big man at that time. He was, you know, he was the thing. And he came through Lake Charles and they were looking for talent. And I think I had to play with that group also. I played with the little band that he had with him. They didn't have a piano, they needed a piano player or…
